title: Robert B Dream vs. Intensive Care Unit Psychosis 5074 NDE 5074
content: I was in a hospital. On the side of the hospital was row upon row of big urns (which resembled large plant pots). They were brown and there was a humming sound. Two shadowy figures with long ton heads slinked in front and back of the urns as if they were in some slow ritual dance. The floors of the hospital were at right angles to each other making it difficult to move from one floor to another. Young hospital interns laid a few pranks on me, one of which involved setting a fire. One nurse was kind to me but got very cross when I said I enacted to leave. My wife, my boss and my parents appeared in the dream. I found the hospital moving so that I woke up one time when the hospital was in Detroit. Later I was in Baltimore, then later in Miami, then later in Rockville, Maryland. When my wife - who was a Latina like me - left to go home, I later became a friend of someone like 'rate and later went to supper with a very kind Jewish man and his family. The floors of their small home were also at right angles to one another. When I went to party at my parents', I passed a large pond filled with stepping-stones. Near the end, the hospital became a ship cruising in the Pacific. I heard people setting off explosions on top of the ship and started. Maneuvering on the awkward floors to get close to the top of the ship where I could see what they were doing. Suddenly I came back to consciousness.
